summary: Recent updates to Firefox have enhanced its media playback capabilities and audio handling. Notably, the browser has improved how it resumes playback after a seek, implementing a **minimal preroll**, which helps ensure smoother transitions and better accuracy in position reporting. Additionally, the handling of audio streams has been refined by addressing issues with zero-frame audio packets, enhancing overall stability and performance. Furthermore, the use of **MOZ_LOG_FMT** across various media components increases logging consistency, aiding in debugging and providing better insights into media interactions for developers. Overall, these changes contribute to a more reliable and efficient media experience in Firefox, benefiting users who consume audio and video content online.
